lines.0: Hi Aarav! Aaj cricket ki ginti se zero se nau tak numbers bolenge aur pehchanenge. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.1: Haan, chaar taaliyan, isliye number chaar! Ab thoda alag socho. Agar ghar ka number saat ho, toh kitni taaliyan bajaoge?
lines.2: Haan, saat number ke liye saat taaliyan! Ab number ka naam pehchano. Seven ko Hindi mein kya bolte hain, aur kaunsa ank hai?
lines.3: Haan, seven yaani saat, aur uska ank 7 hai. Ab nau ka ank kaunsa hai?
lines.4: Nau ka ank 9 hai. Tumne kaha 9 ulta 6 hai; par 6 ko ulta karo toh ank badal jaata hai, chhah nahi rehta. Bholu ne ghar ka 6 ulta likha, kya woh ab bhi chhah hai
lines.5: Haan, 6 ulta ho toh 9 banta hai; dono alag ank hain. Ab ek aur fark batao: 6 aur 9 dikhne mein kaise alag hain?
lines.6: Koi baat nahi, tumne bola pata nahi. Board par 6 ki golai neeche hai, aur 9 ki golai upar hai. Golai upar wale ank ko kya bolte hain?
lines.7: Haan, golai upar wala ank 9 hai. Board par 6 ki golai neeche aur 9 ki upar hai. Ab batao, dono mein fark kya hai?
lines.8: Haan, tumne golai ki jagah sahi batayi. Ab ek chhota sa naya sawal: teen chidiya udd gayin, taar par kitni bachi?
lines.9: Haan, zero chidiya bachi, kyunki sab udd gayin. Zero se hum khaali taar ki ginti batate hain. Cricket mein batsman bina run banaye out ho, toh uska score kya ho
lines.10: Tumne kaha, out hua toh ek run hoga. Par out hona aur run banana alag hain. Do rotiyaan thi, dono kha li. Kitni bachi?
lines.11: Haan, zero roti bachi, kyunki tumne dono kha li. Zero se hum batate hain ki kuch nahi bacha. Cricket mein bina run banaye out ho jao, toh score kitna hoga?
lines.12: Haan, bina run banaye score zero hota hai. Teen se ulta gino: teen, do, ek, phir kya?
lines.13: Haan, ek ke baad ulta ginte hue zero aata hai. Tumne bina hint ke bataya. Ab socho, zero bhi number kyun hai?
lines.14: Koi baat nahi. Score batane ke liye number hota hai. Bina run banaye score zero hota hai. Ek run banaye toh score kya hota hai?

lines.12: Ginte raho, Aarav… phir number batao.
lines.13: Haan, tumne chhah dots gine, isliye number 6 hai. 6 aur 9 thode ek jaise dikhte hain. Inmein fark kya hai?

lines.0: Hi Ananya, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll estimate big collections, like counting many ladoos. What do you like cooking?
lines.1: Chocolate cupcakes with your mummy, and mixing batter—lovely! If peanuts fill a cone, would you pick about 20 or 50?
lines.2: Ananya, pehle 10 peanuts ka group dekho; phir guess karo, aise kitne groups honge. 20 ya 50?
lines.3: Haan, group means 10 peanuts together. Two groups make about 20. Screen par 10-dot group dekho: kitne groups?
lines.4: 4 groups of 10 dikh rahe hain. Ab total peanuts ka estimate batao: about 20, 40, ya 50?
lines.5: Bilkul, 4 groups of 10 means about 40. Ab 10-10 ke groups banaakar actual count check karogi?
lines.6: Screen par heap hidden hai; picture mein 10 marbles ka sample group socho. Us group ko dekhkar 40 ka guess kaise bana?
lines.7: mein 10 batao, kyunki har group mein 10 marbles honge. Ab bolo: 3 groups mein kitne?
lines.8: Har group mein 10 marbles hain. 3 groups ke liye 10 ko teen baar jodo, phir total bolo.
lines.9: Ab 3 groups ka total mil gaya. What do we do next? 40 is ___ to 43, so it was a good estimate.
lines.10: Haan, 40 is close to 43. Tumne 10-10 karke 3 groups count kiye. Peanuts are in 3 paper cones. Each cone has 10 peanuts. How many peanuts in all?
lines.11: Haan, 30 bilkul sahi—tumne 10 ko 3 baar gina. Tumne 3 kyun gina?
lines.12: Bilkul, 3 cones dekhe, isliye 10 ko 3 baar count kiya. I am going to spread these 8 bangles out in a long line. Before I do it: will there be more bangles, fewe
lines.13: Yeh question thoda tricky hai, aur atakna bilkul okay hai. Pehle bangles ko ek-ek karke dekho; line badlegi, ginti nahi. I am going to spread these 8 bangles ou
lines.14: Haan, 8 hi rahenge—tumne objects ki ginti aur unki jagah ko alag samjha. Remember from last time: what is an estimate?

lines.0: Namaste Krish! Main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj hum Farm padhenge. Tumhe farm mein kya dekhna pasand hai?

lines.2: Aur gaay humein...

lines.10: Haan, Krish. Tumne sheep ko uski oon se pehchana. Hindi mein hum kehte hain kutta 'bhau-bhau' karta hai. English mein kutta kya bolta hai?

lines.12: Haan, Krish—tumne sound ko do baar bolkar bilkul theek kaha. Hamari farm wali rhyme ke do jaanwaron ke naam batao.
lines.13: Haan, Krish—cow aur pigeon dono tumne sahi pehchaane. Cow ki English sound “moo” hai; cow kya bolti hai?
lines.14: Chalo, Krish, ab farm ke ek aur jaanwar ki awaaz dhyaan se sunte hain. Duck kya bolti hai?

lines.0: Hi Nisha, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll learn fractions as equal shares. What music do you enjoy?
lines.1: The blue-jersey song on your cycle sounds fun; we’ll return to it later. If we share one roti equally, what happens?
lines.2: Riya gave extra chips, but equal shares match; three equal parts are called thirds—can you point to 1/3?

lines.3: Zeros ginne ka step pakdiye—5,000 mein 3 aur 500 mein 2 zero; ab product likhne ki sochiye.

lines.8: Bilkul, Rudra—5,000 mein 3 aur 500 mein 2 zero, isliye total 5 zero. Ab 5,000 ko 500 se guna karke bataiye.
lines.9: Rudra, aapne 5 guna 5 aur paanch zero bilkul sahi jode: 2,500,000. 60 × 700 nikaaliye.
lines.10: Rudra, 60 ko 6 guna 10 aur 700 ko 7 guna 100 sochiye; pehle 6 guna 7 kijiye. 60 × 700 nikaaliye.
lines.11: Sahi, Rudra—6 guna 7 equals 42, aur teen zero lagakar 42,000. Ab 80 guna 300 mein pehle non-zero digits multiply kijiye.
lines.12: Bilkul, Rudra—non-zero digits aur zeros ko alag rakhkar multiply karna aapne sahi lagaya. Ek cricket club 6,180 tickets ₹480 mein bechta hai. 6,180 ko nearest t
lines.13: Aapne rounding sahi ki, par zeros ginne mein ek step dobara dekhiye: 6,000 mein teen aur 500 mein do zero hain. 6,180 ko nearest thousand aur ₹480 ko nearest hu
lines.14: Rudra, haan—6,000 guna 500 mein 5 zeros hote hain, isliye andaaza ₹30,00,000, yaani 30 lakh hai. 3,000 × 400 kitna hai?

lines.4: Do places shift karne par repeating block align hota hai, isliye subtraction se fraction milta hai. Khaali jagah bhariye: x = 36/99 = ___.

lines.10: Sahi: 15/90 ko 1/6 mein simplify kiya. Aapne 0.1666… mein sirf 6 ko repeat maana—yeh kaise pata chala ki 16 repeat nahi ho raha tha?
lines.11: Bilkul, aapne sahi dekha: 1 ek baar aata hai, aur 6 lagataar repeat hota hai. 0.999… bilkul 1 ke barabar kyun hai? Argument do.
lines.12: Theek hai, Ishaan. Pehle bataiye: x = 0.999…; phir x ko 10 se multiply kijiye, aur bataiye 10x mein decimal digits kaise dikhengi. 0.999… bilkul 1 ke barabar ky
lines.13: Chaliye, step-by-step: maan lijiye x = 0.999…. Ab dono sides ko 10 se multiply kijiye; decimal point ek jagah right shift hoga. 0.999… bilkul 1 ke barabar kyun
lines.14: Koi baat nahi, Ishaan. x = 0.999… toh 10x = 9.999…; ab 10x − x karne par left side kya bachega?

lines.0: Hello Navya! I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll enjoy The Cap-seller and the Monkeys. What music do you like?
lines.1: I’m an AI, so I don’t have favourite songs. Yes—monkeys copy people, like in Simon Says; what might they copy first?
lines.2: A story question asks who, what, or where. Look at the object first, then say its word. What do the monkeys copy?
lines.3: Yes, monkeys copy the cap-seller. Now, who is in the story: the cap-seller or the monkeys?
lines.4: Bilkul, dono story mein hain: cap-seller aur bahut saare monkeys. What do we do next? What happened then? It was hot, so he ___ under a tree.
lines.5: Story picture is yesterday. Echo the past word, then fill the blank. What do we do next? What happened then? It was hot, so he ___ under a tree.
lines.6: Navya, you changed sleep into its past form for a story that already happened. Good self-correction. What do we do next? What happened then? It was hot, so he _
lines.7: Yes, Navya, “slept” is right—the cap-seller rested under the tree in the past. The cap-seller wakes up. His basket is empty! He looks up at the tree. What do yo
lines.8: Navya, you want to stop now—no pressure. Choose: carry on, take a short break, or stop for today?

lines.1: Haan, cheetah bahut fast hota hai. Real picture kuch seconds mein aayegi; meanwhile board uski spotted body, long legs aur tail dikhata hai—look there. Speed ki
lines.2: Bilkul, Diya. Speed batati hai kitna fast; acceleration speed kitni jaldi badalti hai. Cheetah start mein speed jaldi badhata hai—acceleration ya speed?
lines.3: Correct, Diya—speed badal rahi hai, isliye acceleration. Motion-lab mein cheetah ka start observe kariye: speed kitne time mein badhti hai?
lines.4: Chaliye, Diya—pehle 100 km/h ko m/s mein badaliye: 100 ko 5 se multiply karke 18 se divide kariye. Ab acceleration ka next step bataiye.
lines.5: Haan, formula hai: acceleration a equals (v minus u) divided by t. Yahan u zero, v 27.78, t 3. Substitute karke bataiye.
lines.6: Bilkul, Diya: acceleration 9.26 m/s². Iska matlab cheetah ki speed har second lagbhag 9.26 m/s badh rahi hai. Units kyun zaroori hain?
lines.7: Braking mein acceleration zero nahi; velocity decrease hoti hai, so acceleration negative. Board par initial aur final speed dekhkar a equals (v minus u) divide
lines.8: Diya, initial speed 20 m/s aur final speed 5 m/s hai; braking time 3 seconds. Formula mein values substitute karke acceleration nikaliye.
lines.9: A bus slows from 20 m/s to 10 m/s in 5 s. Is it accelerating?
lines.10: Correct: acceleration is negative, meaning velocity is changing because the bus is slowing down. Why can we still call it acceleration?
lines.11: Rabbit 8 m/s se 0 m/s in 4 s: velocity badli, so acceleration hai; a equals (0 minus 8) divided by 4. Value bataiye.
lines.12: Acceleration ka matlab velocity mein change hai, sirf speed badhna nahi; slowing down mein acceleration negative hoti hai. A family drives 60 km to Nani's house
lines.13: Aapne total distance aur total time alag nikale, phir unka ratio liya—yeh average speed ka sahi method hai. What is the average speed for the whole trip? (Not 4
lines.14: Haan, 45 galat hota; average speed 40 km/h hai. Ab isi trip ka displacement sochiye: wapas starting point, toh displacement kya hoga?

lines.0: Hi Kavya, I’m Asha, your AI teacher. Today we’ll explore exponential notation and growth. Which cartoon or cooking show do you enjoy?
lines.1: Shinchan’s funny chaos noted, Kavya; we’ll return to it at the end. Now, folded paper doubles each time—what do you predict after four folds?
lines.2: The counting step broke: doubling gives 2, 4, 8, 16. Four doublings make 16. Can you write 2 repeated four times using powers?

lines.4: You repeated the base five times and identified the exponent correctly. Fill the gap: 2⁷ = ___ layers.
lines.5: You counted the seven factors correctly and expanded the power as repeated multiplication. That is the exact method for evaluating an exponential expression. Fi
lines.6: Haan, aapne 128 bilkul bola tha—meri repeat mistake. Ab negative base dekhiye: (−2)³ mein sign kya hoga, positive ya negative?
lines.7: Your sign steps are correct: two negatives make positive, then multiplying by negative makes negative. So (−2)³ is negative. Now compare 2⁵ and 5². Which is lar
lines.8: You compared 32 and 25. How did those values help you decide which power was larger?
lines.9: Haan, bilkul theek: aapne powers ko ordinary numbers mein badalkar 32 ko 25 se compare kiya. Write 10⁶ as an ordinary number and say it in the Indian number sys
lines.10: Aapne base 10 ko six times multiply karke zeros count kiye—yeh method sahi direction mein hai. Write 10⁶ as an ordinary number and say it in the Indian number s
lines.11: Haan, aapne sahi bola: 10,00,000, yani ten lakh. Ab aapka reason kya hai ki doubling, adding 1,000 twenty times se faster grow karti hai?
lines.12: Exactly: doubling multiplies each time, while adding 1,000 increases by the same amount. Write 64 as a power of 2, as a power of 4 and as a power of 8.
lines.13: Aapne repeated multiplication ko powers mein sahi badla. What is 3⁴?
lines.14: Sahi: 3 ko chaar baar factor ke roop mein use karke 81 milta hai. Write 5 × 5 × 5 × 5 in exponential form. Name the base and the exponent.
